title: fix(app-shell): the draft bar publishes the reloaded draft after a conflict "reload" (#37648)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDJAbBe3iTrFcF7GZrucZ32)_

Fixes #37648

The three review follow-ups PR #37637 left on card #37440: N6 of #37387's review (the runtime draft bar keeps a stale token after "reload") and N1, N2 of contract review 7198547999 (the `publishItem` pin docs).

## What changes

- **Draft bar after a conflict "reload" (`@object-ui/app-shell`).** A view settings Save refused because the draft moved opens the draft-conflict dialog. On "reload", `ViewConfigPanel` re-read the stored view into its buffer, but `handleViewConfigSave` answers `false` on `'reloaded'`, so no `savedSignal` reached `RuntimeDraftBar`, which kept the draft version it read on open. Its Publish was then pinned to a draft that had moved, refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT`, until the panel was reopened.
  - The guard's reload callback is now `handleConflictReload`, which marks the next stored-view read as the reload's. That read, once it installs a buffer, hands the bar the version it found: `reloadedSignal` (bumped), `reloadedDraftVersion` (the `If-Match` of the read's pin; absent when the read named none) and `reloadedHasDraft` (whether a pending draft was served).
  - `RuntimeDraftBar` takes them as it takes `savedSignal`: the Publish is pinned to `reloadedDraftVersion`, and the indicator follows `reloadedHasDraft`. The bar never re-reads for it (#36350: a re-read would pin whatever draft is pending by then, which the panel never showed).
  - A reload whose read fails installs no buffer and hands the bar nothing, so its Publish stays pinned to the draft it showed and is refused, never sent unpinned.
- **`client.meta.publishItem` (`@objectstack/client`).** The `parentVersion` JSDoc now says an empty string pins nothing and is not sent, as `draftVersion`'s does (N1). JSDoc only; `metaPublishHeaders` already treated `''` so.
- **Client SDK page (`content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`).** The `publishItem` example now shows a publish pinned with `draftVersion` (a draft save's receipt `version`) and `parentVersion` (the version the earlier publish returned), with the refusal and the empty-string rule (N2).

## Decisions made here

- **Only `ViewConfigPanel` is changed.** It is the one host of `RuntimeDraftBar` with a draft-conflict guard (`useDraftSaveGuard`); `ReportConfigPanel` and `ReportView` host the bar without one, so no "reload" reaches them.
- **The bar takes the panel's read, not a read of its own,** for the #36350 reason above; and only the read that answers a "reload" is handed over, so an ordinary open, publish or discard behaves as before.

## Verification

- New tests, red on `main` and green here (4 red with the two source files reverted):
  - `ViewConfigPanel.pinnedDraftSave-36137.test.tsx` (2): another writer's draft moves past the panel's receipt, the next Save is refused, "reload" hands the bar that writer's draft version with `reloadedHasDraft: true` (the landed-save signal unmoved); a reload that finds no pending draft hands `reloadedHasDraft: false` and no version.
  - `RuntimeDraftBar.test.tsx` (3): the Publish after `reloadedSignal` sends `draftVersion` = the reloaded version with no second draft read; a reload with no draft takes the indicator down; the mount's own signal changes nothing (control).
- `vitest` over every `ViewConfigPanel*`, `RuntimeDraftBar*`, `ObjectView*`, `DraftConflictDialog*` and `viewCacheInvalidation*` test: 1,059 green. `tsc` for `app-shell` (`tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json`) on the changed files: clean; `eslint`: 0 errors. `check-doc-anchors`: pass.
- `overlap-check`: exit 0 (no open PR touches these files).
- Premise: static read on `main` (`handleViewConfigSave`'s `'reloaded'` → `false`; the bar sets its pin only on open and on `savedSignal`), and the red tests above.
